SELECT avg(try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE customer_segment = 'RES' AND try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) > 0
Which states had the most health-based drinking water violations beginning in 2024?

SELECT substr(pwsid, 1, 2) AS state, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many super PACs registered for the 2024 cycle?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE cmte_tp = 'O' AND cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2024'
Which U.S. counties cover the most land?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many providers are eligible to order and refer under Medicare Part B?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_order_and_referring WHERE partb = 'Y'
Which counties had the lowest per capita income in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' AND try_cast(_2024 AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many security interests in patents were recorded in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS security_interests FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment WHERE convey_text LIKE 'SECURITY%' AND substr(record_dt, 6, 4) = '2023'
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in ChEMBL carry a black box warning?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE black_box_warning = 1
Where was unemployment lowest among the states at the end of 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
What is the combined capacity of America's operating nuclear reactors?
SELECT sum(try_cast(capacity_mwe AS double)) AS total_mwe FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1
Which industries release the most carcinogens?
SELECT _23_industry_sector, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _46_carcinogen = 'YES' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total value of goods imported from Canada in 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS imports FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'CANADA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2019'
Which outcome methods do PubChem bioassays use most often?
SELECT aid2activityoutcomemethod, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod WHERE aid2activityoutcomemethod IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How long does a patent case last on average, from filing to closing?
SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', try_cast(date_filed AS date), try_cast(date_closed AS date)))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE date_closed IS NOT NULL
Which specialties have the most clinicians who graduated after 2015?
SELECT pri_spec, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE try_cast(grd_yr AS double) > 2015 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has national Medicaid drug spending changed each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE state = 'XX' AND try_cast(year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Where has formal Clean Water Act enforcement been heaviest, state by state?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many megawatt hours of wind did the Texas grid produce in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ERCO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which states grew fastest in percentage terms between 2020 and 2025?

SELECT stname, 100 * (try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) - try_cast(popestimate2020 AS double)) / try_cast(popestimate2020 AS double) AS pct_growth FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Do states or EPA issue more informal enforcement actions over discharge permits?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which utilities charge the highest residential rates across the ZIP codes they serve?
SELECT utility_name, avg(try_cast(res_rate AS double)) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE utility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did New York or New England use more electricity at 6 p.m. on July 20, 2023?
SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id IN ('EBA.NYIS-ALL.D.H', 'EBA.ISNE-ALL.D.H') AND period = '20230720T22'
How are applications most often linked to an earlier one: continuation, provisional, division?

SELECT CASE continuation_type WHEN 'CON' THEN 'continuation' WHEN 'PRO' THEN 'claims a provisional' WHEN 'NST' THEN 'national stage' WHEN 'CIP' THEN 'continuation in part' WHEN 'DIV' THEN 'division' WHEN 'REI' THEN 'reissue' ELSE continuation_type END AS link, count(*) AS links FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many unanimous Supreme Court decisions are recorded for the 1990s?
SELECT count(*) AS decisions FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE scdb_id <> '' AND date_filed BETWEEN '1990' AND '2000' AND cast(scdb_votes_minority AS varchar) = '0'
Which products did the United States import the most of in 2023?
SELECT comm_desc, sum(try_cast(gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_comm WHERE year = '2023' AND month = '12' AND comm_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have violators committed to supplemental environmental projects?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_sep AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_penalties
What were the most common reasons for hospital stays in New York in 2016?
SELECT ccs_diagnosis_description, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in penalties has EPA recorded as collected?
SELECT sum(try_cast(penalty_collected_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_penalties
Why do Connecticut consumers complain about insurers most often?
SELECT reason, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ct_insurance_complaints WHERE reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
